Developer hub

Build against the authority layer, the market layer, or the whole fabric.

ENTITY v3.4.3 exposes persistent identity, delegated authority, rights, evidence, a universal transaction fabric, a rights-based exchange engine, economic participation, BTDU information state and provider-independent recovery. Start with the surface closest to your problem.

Market engine

The economic fabric is a first-class developer surface.

DCO → INSTRUMENT → LISTING → DISCLOSURE → ORDER / RFQ / AUCTION → TRADE → CLEARING → SETTLEMENT → ENTITLEMENT → USAGE → ECONOMIC CONSEQUENCE

Execution models

Order book, call auction and RFQ.

Instrument classes

Spot licence, subscription, compute-to-data, procurement, contribution and secondary licence.

Economic participation

Treasuries, reserves, primary/secondary/derivative participation, service revenue and obligations without an automatic protocol tax.

Recovery

Logical recovery of venues, balances, orders, trades, entitlements, usage, revenue rules, payment attestations and participation state.

Wallet builds

Build the current ENTITY Data Economy Terminal.

GitHub Actions builds the full PySide6 wallet on Windows, Linux and macOS from the same canonical source. A separate native SwiftUI iOS Simulator artifact imports portable wallet snapshots and explicitly does not claim native iOS authority/write parity.

Wallet architectureCross-platform workflow
Real external evidence

Build against a system already carrying accepted external contribution lineage.

Vector #26501 / PR #26504 and Memnox #46 / PR #86 are merged upstream and recorded by ENTITY as accepted external contribution histories. Both remain correctly marked pro bono with USD 0 realized cash. They demonstrate durable external problem → contribution → review/CI → acceptance → rights/economic-state lineage.
